sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Distribution of Excess Multilayer Ceramic Capacitors and Resistors

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France — metropolitan territory; single national corporate law regime applicable to SARL (no sub-state company-law distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code; unitary national legal framework; Code de commerce governs corporate matters, supplemented by the Code monétaire et financier for AML/CFT obligations)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 26 November 2013; in force 29 December 2014; effective 1 January 2015)
France–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 30 May 1984; in force; fair-and-equitable treatment, MFN and expropriation protections)
EU–China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (signed 30 December 2020; ratification pending, not in force)
France–Hong Kong SAR Double Taxation Agreement (signed 21 October 2010; in force and effective 2011)
OECD/G20 Multilateral Instrument (MLI) — France is a signatory; anti-abuse, PE and LOB provisions apply to covered DTAAs

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L. 561-1 through L. 561-59 and R. 561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT obligations); Loi n° 2016-731 of 3 June 2016 (Sapin II); beneficial-owner definition and 25% threshold at CMF Article L. 561-2-2; Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE) established by Décret n° 2016-485 of 18 April 2016, filed as an annex to the RCS dossier through the INPI Guichet Unique since 1 January 2023; access restricted following CJEU Joined Cases C-37/20 and C-601/20 (22 November 2022) and implemented by subsequent implementing decrees; Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5) and Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 establishing the European AML Authority (AMLA), with Directive (EU) 2024/1640 (AMLD6) transposable by 10 July 2027; Code de commerce Articles L. 223-1 et seq. (SARL regime); Loi n° 2019-486 of 22 May 2019 (PACTE) governing incorporation and share capital
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (post-CJEU C-37/20 and C-601/20: RBE public access removed; disclosure limited to French competent authorities, TRACFIN, and persons demonstrating a legitimate interest — journalists, civil-society organizations, and AMLD obligated entities performing customer due diligence)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (or legal existence certificate of the foreign corporate shareholder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry (e.g., Companies House, HK Companies Registry, or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961) affixed by the home-country competent authority; non-Hague signatory states require French consular legalization via the Consulate General of France

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (or equivalent extract of the judicial/criminal record for the corporate entity and its directors)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country registrar or Ministry of Justice
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization where the home state is not a Hague signatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Pouvoir) appointing the French incorporation agent and first gérant to sign and file the RCS dossier
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the home jurisdiction, French notaire, or French consular officer abroad
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if issued abroad; otherwise French consular legalization from a non-Hague state; signature verified for statuts sous seing privé

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copies of passports or national identity documents of all UBOs, managers, and authorized signatories
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copies notarized and apostilled; each identity document requires an individual apostille where demanded by the French bank or registrar

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL), Article L.123-35 et seq. (Guichet Unique formalities), Articles R.123-1 et seq. (RCS registration); Ordonnance n°2021-1389 and Décret n°2022-946 implementing the electronic single window.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) held by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office jurisdiction; electronic filings processed via the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'une société (standardized digital incorporation declaration replacing the former M0 dossier) filed through the Guichet Unique, accompanied by the statuts, share capital deposit certificate, legal announcement attestation, and the beneficial owner declaration.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for SARL (Code de commerce, art. L.223-2; a de facto minimum of one euro applies). The capital must be fully subscribed at formation; cash contributions must be paid up to at least 20% upon subscription and deposited in a dedicated blocked account (compte bloqué) opened with a French bank or consigned with a notary through the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; the deposit certificate accompanies the RCS filing and the remaining 80% falls due within five years of registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, FIRST: The share capital of EUR ______ is fully subscribed by the shareholders shown in the register, comprising ______ indivisible shares of EUR ______ each. Cash contributions are paid up to twenty per cent, the balance falling due within five years under Article L.223-7 of the French Commercial Code. RESOLVED, SECOND: The registered office is established at ______, France, and the occupancy document is ratified. RESOLVED, THIRD: ______ is appointed gérant for an indefinite term and vested with full powers under the Code de commerce, including opening bank and tax accounts and filing the incorporation dossier with the Guichet Unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and signature of the Articles of Association and acceptance of the general manager
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders, the appointed gérant, and, where applicable, a notaire when a real-property contribution or notarized lease is involved
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts in French; define the corporate purpose limited to wholesale trade of electronic components (NAF/APE 4652Z), the share capital, management clauses and the statutory duration of 99 years; each shareholder signs every page; the gérant signs the separate acceptance-of-office act and the sworn declaration of no disqualification.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts (Articles of Association) in French
Valid identity documents and proof of address of each shareholder
Acceptance-of-office declaration and non-disqualification declaration signed by the gérant
Commissaire aux apports report, if any in-kind contribution is made
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe, notary or legal review identifies an omitted mandatory clause or inconsistency, cure the defect by a signed avenant (amendment) to the statuts and, when required, re-notarize before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of cash share capital in a blocked bank account and issuance of the capital deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed commercial bank in France, or a notary acting as depository through the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional blocked account in the name of the company in formation ('SARL en formation'); each paying shareholder transfers the cash subscription due at formation; the bank performs KYC/AML verification of shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners; the bank issues the attestation de dépôt des fonds, which must accompany the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts
KYC documentation of each shareholder (passport or national ID, proof of address)
Ultimate beneficial owner declaration (RBE) and source-of-funds statement
Bank account opening form for the company in formation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank raises an AML query, provide the requested ownership chart and source-of-funds evidence within 15 days; if the bank refuses the account, either engage a notary deposit via the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations or select an alternative licensed bank and obtain a fresh deposit certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the legal formation notice in an authorized announcements journal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorized by the préfecture of the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Order the legal announcement containing the corporate name, legal form (SARL), share capital, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, gérant name, and the RCS city of registration; pay the statutory advertising rate; obtain the attestation de parution evidencing the publication date for submission to the RCS.
required_dossiers: Final announcement text
Company name availability confirmation
Extract of the statuts page for verification by the JAL
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL requests textual corrections, amend the announcement and republish without delay; if the attestation is delayed, request an expedited duplicate to preserve the statutory filing deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic incorporation filing at the Guichet Unique and registration at the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet Unique portal (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) with transmission to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office (RCS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create a user account; complete the 'création de société' declaration, enter the statutory information and the beneficial owner data; upload the statutory package; pay the official €54 filing fee; the greffe verifies legal regularity and, upon admission, registers the company and delivers the K-bis extract together with SIREN and SIRET numbers.
required_dossiers: Signed statuts (certified copy)
Share capital deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt des fonds)
Legal announcement publication attestation
Beneficial owner declaration (déclaration de bénéficiaire effectif)
Gérant's acceptance-of-office and non-disqualification declarations
Proof of registered-office enjoyment (lease, utility bill, or owner's consent)
Authority and proof of identity for the signatory of the declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe issues a deficiency notice, respond through the Guichet Unique portal within 15 days; upon correction the file is re-examined within 5 working days; a substantive rejection may be cured by a correction deed (acte rectificatif) or by lodging a fresh complete application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Assignment of SIREN, SIRET and intra-Community VAT identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (SIRENE national identification directory) and Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) for VAT
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following RCS registration, INSEE automatically publishes the SIREN and SIRET identifiers; DGFiP allocates the intra-Community VAT number (FR + two-digit key + SIREN) which is made available in the national EVE portal; the company verifies its VAT registration status and, where necessary, corrects the registered address data.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract
Registered-office address confirmation for SIRET allocation
Confirmation of completion of the DGFiP fiscal identity procedure
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIREN/SIRET or the VAT number is not visible in EVE within 30 days, file an anomaly request with INSEE and DGFiP through their respective online desks; supply the K-bis extract as proof of registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation statutory registration: business tax, social security and customs framework
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DGFiP (Centre de Finances Publiques), URSSAF, and Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) for the EORI reference
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Declare the business premises for the contribution foncière des entreprises (CFE); register the SARL as an employer with URSSAF and set up the DSN payroll channel; if the company will clear goods through customs or use simplified procedures, apply for the French EORI number; verify that no sector-specific environmental declaration is triggered.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract
Business premises declaration (CFE)
URSSAF employer registration form
EORI application file for France
Operational corporate bank account details (IBAN/BIC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For late or refused registrations, submit a rectification request through the relevant online service; administrative decisions may be challenged before the commission de recours amiable within two months of notification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) for classified installations; Direction Générale des Entreprises (DGE) as general industrial policy authority; no industrial licensing board governs wholesale distribution of passive electronic components (ISIC 4652 / NAF 4652Z).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No separate industrial or commercial license is required; the RCS registration (K-bis extract) constitutes the sole general operating authorization; companies performing cross-border import or export operations must obtain an EORI reference from the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) / Ministère de la Transition Écologique
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt (non classée) for office-based wholesale distribution; under ICPE rubrique 1510 (covered warehouses), a simple declaration procedure applies only when the covered storage volume exceeds 5,000 m³, and an authorization is required only above 50,000 m³; no full environmental impact assessment is triggered at the formation stage.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process discharges, combustion sources or VOC emissions arise from passive-component distribution; wastewater discharge into municipal sewerage must comply with Code de l'environnement art. R.1331-2; waste traceability via bordereaux (DID/BSD) under art. L.541-7; packaging take-back and extended-producer-responsibility reporting under the AGEC law (art. L.541-10) through the CITEO/Adelphe channels.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: maintain the registre de sécurité and obtain the applicable ERP or workplace occupancy clearance from the fire prevention commission where the premises receive employees or the public; electrical installation conformity (CONSUEL attestation) for new fit-outs; annual verification of storage racks under Code du travail art. R.4323-72; structural load validation by a certified engineer for mezzanines or racking systems; workplace compliance inspection under Code du travail art. L.4211-1 et seq., with CARSAT notification where applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) of the French Ministry of Economy and Finance; principal taxpayer portal impots.gouv.fr; business incorporation and SIREN/SIRET administrative formalities administered via the INPI Guichet Unique at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; VAT registration, CA3 filing, and VAT identification handled through the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a resident SARL: (1) file incorporation through the INPI Guichet Unique; (2) INSEE assigns the 9-digit SIREN and the SIRET establishment identifier and automatically communicates these to DGFiP; (3) DGFiP attributes the French intra-community VAT number (format FR + 2-digit control key + 9-digit SIREN) upon completion of registration and validation of the file; the entity must be registered without delay from the effective date of taxable activity. For a non-established foreign entity: (1) an EU-established operator may register directly, while a non-EU operator must appoint an ad hoc joint-and-severally liable VAT fiscal representative under CGI Art. 289A; (2) submit the non-resident VAT identification application (cerfa n° 1590-DUE or the harmonized foreign-branch registration form via the Guichet Unique) together with the SIE file evidencing the French taxable transactions; (3) upon approval, obtain the 13-character French VAT ID and thereafter file monthly or quarterly CA3 returns electronically, comply with e-invoicing/e-reporting obligations via the Portail Public de Facturation or an accredited PDP, and maintain a transfer-pricing and documentary file in French.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — a French SARL is by default subject to corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés, IS): reduced flat rate of 15% up to €42,500 of annual taxable profit for Small and Medium Enterprises meeting the statutory size and shareholding conditions, and the standard rate of 25% on the excess; the entity is also a VAT taxable person and remains liable to the territorial economic contribution (CET: CFE plus CVAE, the latter being progressively phased out, and effectively eliminated from 2024) and to the annual 3% levy on distributions where the CGI Art. 235 ter ZC size, turnover, and paid-up-capital conditions are met. A French permanent establishment of a non-resident corporation is taxed on a net-basis at the standard IS rate and, additionally, bears the new equalization minimum tax of 25% on profits deemed distributed unless retained and reinvested for at least two years (CGI Art. 209 al. 4 as amended by the Loi de finances 2023).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Available elections and mandatory markers under French law: (1) CGI Art. 239 bis AA option allowing a qualifying small family SARL - fully paid-up capital and a restricted natural-person family shareholder base - to be taxed as a pass-through partnership-style entity (régime des sociétés de personnes) for a fixed period of five consecutive fiscal years, after which IS taxation resumes; (2) CGI Art. 223 A election enabling a 95%-owned French tax group to consolidate IS liabilities through a société mère intégrée; (3) ATAD anti-hybrid notification and neutralization regime implemented under CGI Arts. 205, 209, and 1649 AD serving as mandatory filing and electivity markers for hybrid and reverse-hybrid mismatch arrangements, including DAC6 cross-border arrangement disclosures; (4) no check-the-box election exists in French domestic law — classification as transparent or entity-level is statutory and derives from the CGI and Book IX accounting rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée — TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For deliveries of goods by a French-established distributor the annual franchise en base de TVA exemption ceiling is €85,000 of turnover (CGI Art. 293 B), with a majoration tolerance of €93,500 for two consecutive years; below this ceiling the SARL may refrain from registering and from charging VAT, but it also forfeits input VAT recovery. Above the franchise ceiling VAT registration is compulsory under the simplified or normal real-regime returns. Non-established foreign suppliers have no equivalent turnover franchise: registration is required by reference to the first taxable supply in France, subject to the €10,000 EU-wide annual distance-sales threshold (Union OSS regime) for EU-established sellers of goods to French final consumers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: National structured e-invoicing mandate phased under the Loi de finances 2023 reform: from 1 September 2026 all French-established taxable persons must be able to receive structured electronic invoices (Factur-X, EN 16931-conformant UBL, or CII format), and large enterprises and ETIs must issue them; from 1 September 2027 SMEs and micro-entities must also issue structured e-invoices. Issuance and transmission must run through an accredited Partenaire de Dématérialisation (PDP) or the public Portail Public de Facturation (PPF), which replaces Chorus Pro. The e-invoice data-set must be delivered to the PPF/PDP within 15 days of invoice issue, and parallel e-reporting of cross-border transaction data and payment data must be transmitted to DGFiP. France does not operate a pre-issue electronic authorization or digital stamping model; the mechanism is interoperable transmission and centralized tax-data warehousing followed by audit inspection rather than real-time fiscal clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported to a destination outside the European Union qualify for zero rating (exonération, equivalent to 0% VAT) under CGI Art. 262-I-1° provided (i) the sale transfers the power of disposal over the goods to the non-EU customer, (ii) the goods are dispatched out of the EU within 12 months of the sale per BOI-TVA-CHAMP-40-20-10, and (iii) the supplier retains full documentary proof of export and physical exit. Intra-EU dispatches of goods to a customer holding a valid EU VAT ID qualify for zero rating as intra-community supplies under CGI Art. 262 ter-1, subject to validation of the customer's VAT number through VIES and filing of the recapitulative statement (Déclaration d'Échanges de Biens, DEB). Offshore services supplied to non-EU customers are outside the scope of French VAT where B2B place-of-supply rules located the service at the customer's non-French establishment (CGI Arts. 259 A and 259 D); however, services relating to tangible goods located in France or services actually performed in France remain subject to French VAT regardless of the customer's residence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: French customs electronic export declaration (Déclaration en douane DELTA/Z or DPE) evidencing the EX1 status and the EU exit date
Transport document proving physical export dispatch: Bill of Lading (ocean), CMR consignment note (road), Air Waybill (air), or rail waybill
Commercial invoice and packing list evidencing the underlying sale, quantity, unit values, and consignment particulars

Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT statement proving the receipt and crediting of export proceeds to the French exporting SARL, supporting the FX repatriation benchmark and transfer-pricing documentation

For intra-EU dispatches: validated EU customer VAT ID (VIES certificate) and the recapitulative DEB statement; also the transaction-level e-reporting records transmitted via PPF/PDP for customs statistics
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The taxpayer is exposed to the ordinary 3-year statutory reassessment window (LPF Art. L169), extended to 10 years for international transactions and operations involving entities established abroad under LPF Art. L169 B. If zero rating is refused because export documentation is missing, inconsistent, or goods are shown never to have left the French/EU customs territory, VAT is recomputed at 20% with retroactive effect, previously recovered input VAT is clawed back, and late interest accrues at 0.20% per month. Applicable penalties escalate from 40% for material under-declaration (CGI Art. 1731), to 80% for deliberate concealment (CGI Art. 1729), and to 100% for fraudulent maneuvers (CGI Art. 1732). Criminal tax-fraud prosecution under CGI Art. 1741 may result in up to five years imprisonment and a fine of up to €500,000 for fictitious or sham export schemes, coupled with customs smuggling penalties up to three years imprisonment under Code des douanes Art. 414 and joint-and-several civil liability of the management and the appointed French VAT fiscal representative.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), acting with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) as foreign-exchange policy co-authority, and the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) as the licensing and AML supervisory authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a Eurozone member; the euro is fully convertible and the capital account is completely liberalised under Articles 63-66 TFEU. There is no national exchange-control authorisation for trade payments, profit repatriation, equity injections, intercompany loans or divestment proceeds. Current-account transactions (goods, services, royalties) are unrestricted; capital-account transactions (equity, loans, guarantees) are equally unrestricted but carry statistical declaration duties to Banque de France. Profit remittances by a French SARL to non-resident shareholders are free from exchange-control approval but remain subject to French withholding tax at the statutory 25% on dividends (Article 119 bis CGI), with full release at 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for qualifying EU corporate shareholders holding at least 10% (2-year holding condition), and 0-15% treaty relief for other treaty jurisdictions; the underlying SARL profit is taxed at the 25% standard French corporate income tax rate (15% reduced rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs). Practical hurdles are documentary only: balance-of-payments reporting, UBO filing in the RCS, source-of-funds evidence and EU/UN sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio exist in France. Export proceeds from the distribution of MLCCs and resistors may be retained indefinitely in foreign-currency bank accounts (comptes de devises) held with French authorised credit institutions, or converted freely into EUR or other currencies. No statutory timeline requires repatriation or conversion. The only binding obligations are statistical and customs-related: cross-border payments or collections of EUR 15,000 or more must be captured in the bank balance-of-payments reporting to Banque de France; commercial goods exports must be declared to customs under SAD/ECS and, when volume thresholds in the calendar year are exceeded, to Intrastat; direct investment and intercompany financing transactions of EUR 15,000 or more must be declared separately by the enterprise to Banque de France within 20 calendar days. Penalties for non-declaration follow the French Customs Code and Article L132-2 of the French Monetary and Financial Code.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with Multi-Currency Settlement and SWIFT Corporate Access
Operational Account with FX Lines and Supply-Chain Finance
Operational Account and Documentary Credit Service
Operational Account with Trade Finance Corridor
Operational Account with International Payments Platform
Operational Account with Cross-Border Credit Line and Global Connectivity

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as a secondary operational account for SEPA, virtual IBANs and low-value outbound wires, but Low as the primary vehicle for SWIFT MT103 trade settlements, documentary letters of credit, or FX hedging. An ACPR-licensed fintech EMI (Qonto, Shine, Treezor) can lawfully hold safeguarding accounts for the SARL under the PSD2 and EMD2 frameworks, yet such an account is not a bank deposit and is not covered by the Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts; EMI licences also do not authorise lending, credit intermediation, LC confirmation or the issuance of guarantees. Foreign non-EU digital banks without an ACPR branch, an EU passport, or a French credit-institution partner cannot lawfully open a resident corporate account and would constitute unauthorised payment-service activity under Articles L511-1 et seq. and L521-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A non-EU resident gérant (director) or majority beneficial owner must normally appear physically at a French branch of the relationship bank for the initial KYC interview and signature specimen; remote video identification alone is not uniformly accepted by Tier-1 French banks for non-EU nationals. An EU-resident gérant may complete onboarding through ACPR-compliant video identification plus notarised/apostilled corporate documents, sworn French translations, and a short live interview. A French-resident gérant may often open fully remotely using France Identité and electronic signature. In all cases the bank requires the original legalised articles (statuts), a current RCS Kbis extract, UBO (bénéficiaires effectifs) declaration filed in the trade register, and a completed source-of-funds questionnaire; the physical visit is strongly recommended within 3 months after remote opening to lift payment and transfer limits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: non-EU beneficial owner is domiciled in a jurisdiction without adequate AML regulation or not present in France.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled and sworn-translated articles of association, Kbis extract under 3 months old, notarised authorisation of the French gérant, commercial-space lease or serviced-office agreement in France, proof of an active corporate phone and separate business address, certificates of tax residence of both the entity and the owner, bank reference letters from the owner's primary bank, and a detailed source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statement with supporting asset/income documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: passive electronic components distribution with rapid inventory turnover and no visible warehousing, suggesting gray-market or dual-use transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authorised distributor or excess-stock purchase agreements from recognised component chains (Arrow, Avnet, TTI, Mouser or their franchisees), supplier invoices with lot/date codes, batch-level dealer manifests and packing lists, customs SAD declarations for imports into France, an EU Dual-Use Regulation (EU) 2021/821 classification statement confirming no controlled commodity, and a compliance attestation that all MLCC and resistor volumes are EAR99/AA-E1 non-controlled items.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: large and frequent shareholder current-account (compte courant d'associé) credits from a related non-EU party lacking documented commercial delivery.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written intercompany loan agreement with market-rate interest and repayment schedule, notarised shareholder resolution approving the funding, use-of-funds schedule matched to supplier invoices, arm's-length transfer-pricing documentation under OECD Chapter VI, the Banque de France direct-investment declaration for amounts EUR 15,000 and above within 20 days, and a group organisational statement confirming the business purpose of the funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: inconsistent SWIFT purpose codes (e.g., personal remittance or financing codes on corporate account) pointing to layering or undisclosed treasury flow.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full invoice-to-payment reconciliation report from the SARL ERP, underlying purchase orders and delivery notes, bills of lading and customs entries, a declared expected-payment matrix listing counterparties by jurisdiction and amount band, and an independent accountant's attestation of the trade cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: nominal capital SARL (EUR 1-100) requesting substantial documentary credit lines, unsecured credit, or FX hedging without public financial statements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Interim management accounts, 24-month forward business plan, third-party logistics warehouse contract evidencing real inventory, parent-company guarantee or standby letter of credit, bank reference letters, cash-flow evidence via Open Banking, and, where applicable, trade-credit insurance (Coface) covering the main customers.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are executed by SWIFT MT103 for the euro leg (or MT202 for nostro covers) from the foreign parent to the SARL account held at a French Tier-1 bank. The remittance instructions must carry the ISO 20022 purpose code 'CABP' (capital payments) for shareholder loans or 'EQUI' (equity) for capital contributions, together with a French balance-of-payments economic nature (direct investment equity or intercompany financing). The SARL must file the Banque de France direct-investment declaration for any transaction of EUR 15,000 or more within 20 calendar days; a copy of the filed declaration, notarised corporate minutes approving the funding, the legalised shareholders' agreement, signatures on the account mandate verifying the gérant, RCS UBO update, and evidence of registration of any capital increase (fixed registration duty of EUR 500) complete the verification pack. No prior exchange-control authorisation is necessary.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements use: (i) SWIFT MT103 open-account wires to suppliers in EUR, USD, CNH, JPY, THB and KRW with invoice-referencing remittance fields; (ii) documentary commercial letters of credit issued by the French bank under UCP600 for large MLCC/resistor procurement, normally confirmed by a bank in the supplier country; (iii) SEPA Credit Transfer and SEPA Instant for EU suppliers; (iv) TARGET2 for high-value euro payments within Europe, with USD cleared via CHIPS/FedWire and CNY via CIPS as required. The French bank performs automatic Banque de France balance-of-payments capture for all cross-border payments of EUR 15,000 or greater, and the SARL must keep invoice, transport and customs declarations for each disbursement to satisfy evidentiary audit.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable spot and forward foreign-exchange contracts (change à terme) up to 24 months on EUR/USD, EUR/CNH, EUR/JPY and EUR/KRW, supported by documented underlying trade exposure and reported under EMIR.
FX swaps and swap-rollover treasury operations in G10 currencies executed with the relationship bank's capital-markets desk.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (CIRS) converting foreign-currency intercompany funding into EUR for the SARL's funding model.
Vanilla purchased FX options (EUR/USD and EUR/CNH) hedging import costs and preserving upside on AP spreads.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on non-fully-convertible Asian and African currencies only where the trade receivable or payable is non-deliverable; EMIR reporting and uncleared margin rules apply.
Commodity swaps and commodity-indexed derivatives are not permissible for this passive distribution scope because no physical commodity inventory is held for hedging against input-price movements.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting approving the statutory annual accounts (assemblée générale ordinaire)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate record; not filed with any agency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after the fiscal year-end; one meeting must be held annually
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court petition by any shareholder for failure to approve accounts; risk of nullity of shareholder decisions; no valid RCS accounts filing while approval is missing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts and statutory reports lodged with the commercial registry (dépôt des comptes annuels au RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after shareholder approval and no later than 7 months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Coercive court order (astreinte) to deposit; late-filing fines; repeated non-filing exposes the entity to administrative strike-off/radiation from the RCS and public-prosecutor enforcement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and financial-statements annexes (liasse fiscale)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques - Service des Impôts des Entreprises (DGFIP/SIE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year accounts, by the 2nd working day after 1 May; fiscal years ending other dates, within 3 months after the fiscal year-end; e-filing deadlines published by DGFIP
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 5% plus 0.20% per month, statutory interest for late payment, and 40% penalty for intentional understatement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial-owner declaration update/confirmation (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce within the RCS file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any change in direct or indirect ownership or control; no annual re-filing is required when no change has occurred
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 7,500 for a natural person and EUR 37,500 for a legal person; imprisonment up to 6 months for intentional concealment/false declaration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A SARL must appoint at least one commissaire aux comptes when two of the following three thresholds are exceeded at the balance-sheet date: total assets over EUR 4,000,000; net turnover excluding tax over EUR 8,000,000; average workforce over 50 employees; audit may also be required by the articles or by shareholder demand.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts must be prepared under French GAAP (Autorité des Normes Comptables ANC regulation 2016-06, Plan Comptable Général) in euros; IFRS applies in France to consolidated accounts of listed public-interest entities only.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France imposes no standalone annual UBO filing if the declared data is unchanged. The beneficial-owner declaration is filed on incorporation and must be updated at the RCS within 30 days after any share transfer or ownership/control change. The annual accounts deposit serves as the recurring registry confirmation checkpoint; shares cannot be evidenced in bearer form for an SARL.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / share transfers (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors / Manager Decisions (registre des décisions du gérant)
Minute Book (registre des décisions des associés / procès-verbaux)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 170 - 450 per annum for commercial domiciliation services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 - 18,000 per annual audit for a distribution SARL above statutory thresholds; no charge if the entity is below thresholds and no voluntary audit is appointed

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate on first €42,500 taxable income for SMEs with turnover below €7.63 million; R&D tax credit up to 30% of qualifying expenditures; accelerated depreciation allowances

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1200-A (Déclaration de résultat) filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only French-sourced net turnover for non-residents
Deduct only expenses attributable to French operations

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: €125 per day late filing penalty, capped at €75,000; potential criminal sanctions

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1200-A supporting schedules and TP adjustments

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents calculate based on French permanent establishment or source income only

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Daily surcharges and potential imprisonment for fraud

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) and submit application for DTA relief to French tax authorities via impots.gouv.fr
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% to 10% based on treaty; Interest: 0% under EU rules or applicable treaties

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: French Economic Substance Regulations require adequate economic substance in France for certain entities and activities

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of taxable income or false reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties including up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to 80% of evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal criminal liability, restitution orders, and possible imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit CIT return by deadline
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fine of €125 per day, maximum €75,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held jointly and severally liable for penalties

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using non-arm's length prices without documentation or adjustment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 5% of the adjusted amount or more
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors liable for restitution of underpaid tax and potential fines

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without sufficient French-based management or employees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of entity and imposition of penalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing of corporate veil leading to personal liability for tax obligations
